<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<style>
#dgsusa-page,
#dgsusa-page *{box-sizing:border-box!important;margin:0;padding:0;font-family:"Manrope",Arial,sans-serif!important}
#dgsusa-page{--bg:#05050b;--panel:#0d0d17;--panel2:#141323;--line:rgba(255,255,255,.12);--text:#fff;--muted:rgba(255,255,255,.68);--soft:rgba(255,255,255,.06);--orange:#e8612a;--pink:#ff2d91;--violet:#7b4dff;--blue:#168dff;--green:#1f9d62;--grad:linear-gradient(135deg,#e8612a 0%,#ff2d91 52%,#7b4dff 100%);width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;overflow:hidden!important;background:#05050b!important;color:#fff!important;line-height:1.65!important;position:relative!important}
#dgsusa-page a{text-decoration:none!important;color:inherit!important}
#dgsusa-page img{max-width:100%!important;display:block!important}
#dgsusa-page .dgs-wrap{width:min(1540px,calc(100% - 48px))!important;margin:0 auto!important;position:relative!important;z-index:2!important}
#dgsusa-page .dgs-bg{position:fixed!important;inset:0!important;z-index:0!important;pointer-events:none!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#05050b 0%,#080713 100%)!important;overflow:hidden!important}
#dgsusa-page .dgs-bg:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-18%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 18% 18%,rgba(0,212,255,.20),transparent 18%),radial-gradient(circle at 26% 28%,rgba(255,94,184,.24),transparent 26%),radial-gradient(circle at 82% 18%,rgba(157,78,221,.28),transparent 28%),radial-gradient(circle at 68% 60%,rgba(255,119,199,.16),transparent 26%),radial-gradient(circle at 48% 86%,rgba(171,98,255,.26),transparent 32%),linear-gradient(135deg,#020202 0%,#090210 38%,#120317 62%,#020202 100%)!important;filter:blur(24px) saturate(1.1)!important;opacity:.9!important;animation:dgsUsMistDrift 24s ease-in-out infinite alternate!important}
@keyframes dgsUsMistDrift{from{transform:translate3d(-1.5%,-1%,0) scale(1.02)}to{transform:translate3d(1.5%,-2%,0) scale(1.08)}}
#dgsusa-page .dgs-bg:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-20%;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.045) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.045) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:54px 54px;transform:rotate(7deg);opacity:.42}
#dgsusa-page .dgs-orb{position:absolute;width:460px;height:460px;border-radius:50%;filter:blur(70px);opacity:.58;mix-blend-mode:screen}
#dgsusa-page .orb-a{left:-120px;top:40px;background:#e8612a}
#dgsusa-page .orb-b{right:-140px;top:210px;background:#ff2d91}
#dgsusa-page .orb-c{left:48%;top:420px;background:#7b4dff}
#dgsusa-page .orb-d{right:18%;bottom:3%;background:#168dff;opacity:.34}
#dgsusa-page .grad-text{background:var(--grad)!important;-webkit-background-clip:text!important;background-clip:text!important;color:transparent!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent!important}
#dgsusa-page .eyebrow{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:9px!important;font-size:11px!important;font-weight:900!important;letter-spacing:.16em!important;text-transform:uppercase!important;color:#ff9a68!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#ff9a68!important;padding:9px 15px!important;border-radius:999px!important;border:1px solid rgba(232,97,42,.30)!important;background:rgba(232,97,42,.10)!important;margin-bottom:18px!important}
#dgsusa-page .eyebrow:before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#e8612a;box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(232,97,42,.8)}
#dgsusa-page .dgs-section{position:relative!important;z-index:1!important;padding:96px 0!important;background:transparent!important}
#dgsusa-page .dgs-head{max-width:980px!important;margin:0 auto 50px!important;text-align:center!important}
#dgsusa-page .dgs-head h2{font-size:clamp(36px,4.6vw,70px)!important;line-height:1.02!important;letter-spacing:-.065em!important;font-weight:950!important;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;margin:0 0 18px!important}
#dgsusa-page .dgs-head p{font-size:17px!important;line-height:1.75!important;color:var(--muted)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:var(--muted)!important;max-width:820px!important;margin:0 auto!important}
#dgsusa-page .dgs-btn{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:center!important;gap:10px!important;min-height:56px!important;border-radius:999px!important;padding:15px 24px!important;font-size:14px!important;font-weight:900!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14)!important;transition:.25s ease!important}
#dgsusa-page .dgs-btn-primary{background:var(--grad)!important;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;box-shadow:0 22px 60px rgba(255,45,145,.28)!important}
#dgsusa-page .dgs-btn-dark{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)!important;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important}
#dgsusa-page .dgs-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)!important}

/* HERO */
#dgsusa-page .hero{min-height:820px!important;padding:105px 0 88px!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;position:relative!important;z-index:1!important}
#dgsusa-page .hero-grid{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.05fr) minmax(420px,.95fr)!important;gap:54px!important;align-items:center!important}
#dgsusa-page .hero h1{font-size:clamp(44px,5.65vw,88px)!important;line-height:1.04!important;letter-spacing:-.065em!important;font-weight:950!important;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;margin:0 0 24px!important;max-width:920px!important;text-wrap:balance!important}
#dgsusa-page .hero-sub{font-size:18px!important;line-height:1.78!important;color:rgba(255,255,255,.72)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:rgba(255,255,255,.72)!important;max-width:780px!important;margin:0 0 30px!important}
#dgsusa-page .hero-actions{display:flex!important;gap:14px!important;flex-wrap:wrap!important;margin-bottom:34px!important}

#dgsusa-page .hero-service-pills{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)!important;gap:12px!important;max-width:790px!important;margin:0 0 34px!important}
#dgsusa-page .hero-service-pill{min-height:48px!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;border-radius:16px!important;padding:13px 16px!important;color:rgba(255,255,255,.84)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:rgba(255,255,255,.84)!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.045)!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15)!important;box-shadow:0 18px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.12)!important;font-size:13px!important;font-weight:900!important;line-height:1.25!important;transition:.25s ease!important}
#dgsusa-page .hero-service-pill:hover{transform:translateY(-3px)!important;border-color:rgba(232,97,42,.36)!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07)!important}
#dgsusa-page .service-ticker-section{position:relative!important;z-index:2!important;padding:0 0 42px!important;margin-top:-24px!important;overflow:hidden!important}
#dgsusa-page .service-ticker-wrap{width:100%!important;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10)!important;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10)!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.035)!important;backdrop-filter:blur(10px)!important;-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px)!important;overflow:hidden!important}
#dgsusa-page .service-ticker-track{display:flex!important;width:max-content!important;gap:14px!important;align-items:center!important;padding:18px 0!important;animation:dgsServiceTicker 34s linear infinite!important}
#dgsusa-page .service-ticker-track:hover{animation-play-state:paused!important}
#dgsusa-page .service-ticker-item{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:10px!important;white-space:nowrap!important;border-radius:999px!important;padding:11px 18px!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.055)!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13)!important;color:rgba(255,255,255,.82)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:rgba(255,255,255,.82)!important;font-size:12px!important;font-weight:950!important;letter-spacing:.08em!important;text-transform:uppercase!important}
#dgsusa-page .service-ticker-item:before{content:""!important;width:7px!important;height:7px!important;border-radius:50%!important;background:#e8612a!important;box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(232,97,42,.75)!important}
@keyframes dgsServiceTicker{0%{transform:translateX(0)}100%{transform:translateX(-50%)}}
#dgsusa-page .hero-proof{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)!important;gap:12px!important;max-width:790px!important}
#dgsusa-page .proof{padding:18px!important;border-radius:20px!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.055)!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12)!important;box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.16)!important}
#dgsusa-page .proof strong{display:block!important;font-size:26px!important;font-weight:950!important;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;line-height:1!important;margin-bottom:8px!important}
#dgsusa-page .proof span{display:block!important;font-size:12.5px!important;line-height:1.45!important;color:rgba(255,255,255,.62)!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:rgba(255,255,255,.62)!important}


/* HERO SERVICES VISUAL - REPLACES PROOF CARDS */
#dgsusa-page .hero-service-system{position:relative!important;min-height:560px!important;border-radius:34px!important;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.095),rgba(255,255,255,.04))!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14)!important;box-shadow:0 34px 100px rgba(0,0,0,.30)!important;overflow:hidden!important;padding:28px!important;isolation:isolate!important}
#dgsusa-page .hero-service-system:before{content:""!important;position:absolute!important;inset:0!important;background:radial-gradient(circle at 18% 12%,rgba(232,97,42,.25),transparent 34%),radial-gradient(circle at 82% 22%,rgba(255,45,145,.22),transparent 36%),radial-gradient(circle at 52% 82%,rgba(123,77,255,.24),transparent 36%)!important;z-index:-2!important}
#dgsusa-page .hero-service-system:after{content:""!important;position:absolute!important;inset:-40%!important;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.045) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.045) 1px,transparent 1px)!important;background-size:44px 44px!important;transform:rotate(7deg)!important;opacity:.42!important;z-index:-1!important;animation:dgsHeroGridMove 16s linear infinite alternate!important}
@keyframes dgsHeroGridMove{0%{transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotate(7deg)}100%{transform:translate3d(44px,28px,0) rotate(8deg)}}
#dgsusa-page .service-visual-top{display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:space-between!important;gap:14px!important;margin-bottom:26px!important;position:relative!important;z-index:2!important}
#dgsusa-page .visual-chip{display:inline-flex!important;align-items:center!important;gap:8px!important;border-radius:999px!important;padding:9px 14px!important;background:rgba(232,97,42,.12)!important;border:1px solid rgba(232,97,42,.30)!important;color:#ff9a68!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#ff9a68!important;font-size:10px!important;font-weight:950!important;letter-spacing:.13em!important;text-transform:uppercase!important}
#dgsusa-page .visual-chip:before{content:""!important;width:7px!important;height:7px!important;border-radius:50%!important;background:#e8612a!important;box-shadow:0 0 14px rgba(232,97,42,.8)!important}
#dgsusa-page .visual-status{display:inline-flex!important;border-radius:999px!important;padding:8px 12px!important;background:rgba(31,157,98,.11)!important;border:1px solid rgba(31,157,98,.24)!important;color:#bfffdc!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#bfffdc!important;font-size:10px!important;font-weight:950!important;letter-spacing:.12em!important;text-transform:uppercase!important}
#dgsusa-page .service-core{position:relative!important;z-index:2!important;border-radius:28px!important;background:rgba(5,5,11,.58)!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13)!important;padding:24px!important;margin-bottom:18px!important;overflow:hidden!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.03),0 24px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.25)!important}
#dgsusa-page .service-core h3{font-size:32px!important;line-height:1.08!important;letter-spacing:-.05em!important;font-weight:950!important;color:#fff!important;-webkit-text-fill-color:#fff!important;margin:0 0 10px!important}

#dgsusa-page .service-map{position:relative!important;z-index:2!important;display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)!important;gap:12px!important;margin-top:18px!important}
#dgsusa-page .service-node{position:relative!important;min-height:88px!important;border-radius:20px!important;padding:16px 16px 16px 46px!important;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)!important;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13)!important;overflow:hidden!important;transition:.25s ease!important;animation:dgsNodeFloat 5s ease-in-out infinite!important}

@keyframes dgsNodeFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-7px)}}
#dgsusa-page .service-node:before{content:""!important;position:absolute!important;left:16px!important;top:18px!important;width:16px!important;height:16px!important;border-radius:6px!important;background:var(--grad)!important;box-shadow:0 0 18px rgba(255,45,145,.35)!important}
